title: Construction of Drainage Structure along Road, Metro Iloilo Radial RD (R4 Bypass RD)
description: CONSTRUCTION OF DRAINAGE STRUCTURE ALONG ROAD - METRO ILOILO RADIAL RD (R4 BYPASS RD) - K0010 + 773 - K0011+078
colour_meaning: Review: one strong sign of risk, or two weaker ones.

reasons.title: Price per km above 90% of similar works
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱155.8M per km; the 90th percentile of similar works (Drainage along roads, 112 past contracts) is ₱97.0M per km. Length read from the title: 305 m.
reasons.evidence: A weaker version of the price sign.
checks: Check the stated length and the scope, as for the stronger price sign.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: A.D. Pendon Construction & Supply, Inc.: 1 of 191 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

reasons.title: The winner's other projects drew citizen reports
reasons.detail: RITCHE-NATHALIE DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (FORMERLY: RITCHE-NATHALIE  BUILDERS AND GEN. MERCHANDISE) has 3 other DPWH projects reported by citizens (ghost/defective/unfinished tags)
reasons.evidence: A contractor whose other roads drew 2+ citizen reports had about 4.5 times the odds of a report.
checks: Open the winner's reported projects on the DPWH Transparency Portal and read what citizens reported.
Plan a site visit or ask a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, TAPAT) to look once work starts.

reasons.title: Citizen inspectors rated the winner's other work unsatisfactory
reasons.detail: RITCHE-NATHALIE DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (FORMERLY: RITCHE-NATHALIE  BUILDERS AND GEN. MERCHANDISE) has 3 project(s) rated unsatisfactory by Bisto citizen site inspectors
more: RITCHE-NATHALIE DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (FORMERLY: RITCHE-NATHALIE  BUILDERS AND GEN. MERCHANDISE) has 3 project(s) rated unsatisfactory by Bisto citizen site inspectors
reasons.evidence: From Bisto Proyekto volunteer site inspections.
checks: Open the inspections of the winner's other projects on bisto.ph.
